eas_text: A civil authority has issued A LOCAL AREA EMERGENCY for the following counties or areas: Twin Falls, ID; at 10:41 PM on SEP 3, 2026 Effective until 12:41 AM SEP 4, 2026. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: This is an activation of the Endangered Missing Person Alert system.  The Buhl Police Department is looking for Michael Johnson an 84 year old male Unknown race 5ft 10inches tall 198 lbs with white hair green eyes and a full white beard.  He was last seen wearing a white t-shirt grey shorts and grayish brown boots leaving a care facility on Sprague Avenue in Buhl ID on foot and is believed to be in danger. If you have any information on the where abouts of this missing person please contact the Buhl Police Department at 2083241911.
